faq.question: Can I migrate my existing reviews from another Shopify app?
faq.answer: Yes! Our one-click importer supports direct CSV and API migrations from Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo, Stamped, and Okendo with zero loss of ratings or images.

faq.question: How do Google Rich Snippets work with Reviora?
faq.answer: Reviora automatically injects valid Schema.org AggregateRating structured data into your product pages, enabling Google search to display your star count and review rating directly in organic search results.

faq.question: Are review request emails customizable?
faq.answer: Completely. You can customize branding, colors, logos, timing schedules, and incentivize buyers with dynamic discount coupon codes.

faq.question: Does Reviora support multi-language stores?
faq.answer: Yes, Reviora works seamlessly with Shopify Markets and translation tools like Langify and Weglot.

faq.question: Will Zenspeed break my custom Shopify theme or installed apps?
faq.answer: No. Zenspeed uses non-destructive optimizations and native Shopify Theme App Extensions, ensuring all your tracking pixels, analytics, and theme customizations stay intact.

faq.question: How quickly will my store speed improve after installing?
faq.answer: Most stores see an immediate 20–40 point jump in Google PageSpeed Insights and sub-second page loads within minutes of activation.

faq.question: How does Zenspeed help my Google search rankings?
faq.answer: Faster page load times directly improve Google's Core Web Vitals ranking factor, while automated JSON-LD schemas generate star ratings and rich snippets in search results.
